additive: ordinary least squares: story intercepts, (way-10)/4, (three-2)/3, luck and traps. One row per cell mean; report held-out cell median absolute error. No clipping or fabricated coefficients.
holdout: hash(story,way,three,luck,traps=0) mod5==0. Repeated seeds and trap1 addenda inherit the trap0 parent fold to prevent leakage.
frozenGuards: After main ratings, freeze a diagnostic plan for lowest and highest pooled-family frozenGuards boards (id tie break). Compare original, noIce, noLocks, noClock and allFaceUp with matching full settings. Require an engine proof before measuring an ablation. allFaceUp changes peek-pair availability as well as information.
pilot: Only if at least one observed range cell reaches both bands. Up to 5 boards per missing slot, all first-check outcomes retained; existing Task09 qualification and current 20 boards preserved.
